tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us

tr.td: The patient shows mild leukocytosis, slightly decreased erythrocyte count, and a markedly elevated platelet distribution width, while other red cell and platelet parameters are within normal limits. These findings may indicate an acute or recent inflammatory or infectious process. Correlation with clinical symptoms and further evaluation is recommended.
